core: Golgi nucleotide-sugar supply for glycoconjugate synthesis
name: Nucleotide-sugar transport defects, GDP-fucose and glycosphingolipid synthesis
rationale: Members cover SLC35/SLC33A1 transporter defects that supply Golgi glycosylation substrates plus GDP-fucose and glycosphingolipid/ganglioside synthesis, the latter two being absent from all confusables (which carry UDP-sugar, PAPS or N-glycan pathways instead).

name: FGFR4-betaKlotho signaling and FGFR phospholipase C-gamma cascades
rationale: All members are FGFR downstream cascades, centred on FGFR4 (FRS, SHC, PI3K, betaKlotho) and PLC-gamma cascades of FGFR1/3/4, whereas confusables carry PI3K/FRS/SHC cascades of FGFR1-3.

name: TCR signaling with CD28 costimulation and co-inhibition
rationale: Members describe TCR proximal and downstream signaling and its tuning, and the CD28 costimulatory and CTLA4/BTLA co-inhibitory pathways distinguish it from confusables focused on BCR signaling or T cell differentiation.

core: Regulation of vascular smooth muscle cell behavior
name: Regulation of vascular smooth muscle proliferation and migration
rationale: All members regulate vascular smooth muscle cell proliferation, migration or differentiation, with bidirectional proliferation/migration control distinguishing it from confusables about phenotypic switching, remodeling or endothelial activation.

name: Redox detoxification and direct DNA alkylation reversal
rationale: Members span ROS, aldehyde and methylglyoxal detoxification, NADPH supply and protein repair, and the ALKBH/MGMT direct alkylation reversal members are what no confusable (glutathione, ferroptosis, ascorbate) contains.

name: Opsin-mediated phototransduction and light detection
rationale: Members concern light absorption by opsins and activation/recovery of the phototransduction cascade including cone opsin defects, distinguishing it from confusables on the retinoid cycle and photoreceptor development.

qualifier: Sanfilippo and Morquio (heparan and keratan sulfate)
name: Lysosomal GAG degradation in Sanfilippo and Morquio syndromes
rationale: All members are lysosomal HS, KS or CS/DS degradation and the MPS III/IV disorders, while confusables hold MPS I, II, VI, VII and IX.

core: Hematopoietic stem and progenitor cell regulation
name: Hematopoietic stem and progenitor regulation with erythroid differentiation
rationale: Members regulate HSC homeostasis, proliferation and differentiation (including RUNX1 and myeloid progenitor programmes) and erythrocyte differentiation, which confusables on lymphoid/myeloid inhibition or stem cell maintenance lack.

qualifier: netrin and semaphorin-plexin signaling with axon extension
name: Netrin and semaphorin-plexin axon guidance and extension
rationale: All members are axon guidance and projection extension with netrin and semaphorin-plexin signaling, while confusables emphasize Sema3A chemorepulsion and negative regulation of extension.

qualifier: specialized pro-resolving resolvins, protectins, maresins, lipoxins
name: Specialized pro-resolving lipid mediator biosynthesis
rationale: Members synthesize resolvins, protectins, maresins, lipoxins and related HETE precursors, whereas confusables cover leukotrienes, hepoxilins and eicosanoid catabolism.

qualifier: peroxisomal very-long-chain oxidation and ether lipid synthesis
name: Peroxisomal very-long-chain fatty acid and ether lipid metabolism
rationale: Members cover peroxisomal alpha/beta-oxidation of VLCFA and branched chains, fatty acid elongation and plasmalogen/ether lipid synthesis, distinct from confusables on peroxisomal protein import and bile acid synthesis.

qualifier: putrescine and spermidine synthesis and transport
name: Putrescine and spermidine synthesis and transport
rationale: All members concern ODC-driven putrescine/spermidine synthesis and polyamine transport, unlike confusables on polyamine interconversion, ornithine/arginine metabolism or organic cation transport.

name: Eosinophil and mast cell differentiation and eosinophil activation
rationale: Members cover eosinophil differentiation, chemotaxis, activation and effector immunity plus mast cell/granulocyte differentiation, while confusables are Th2 and IL-4/IL-13/IL-33 cytokine pathways.

qualifier: AU-rich element binding proteins and stress granules
name: ARE-mediated mRNA turnover and stress granule dynamics
rationale: Members cover deadenylation, decapping and ARE-binding protein control of mRNA stability and translation, and the stress granule, PKR and arsenite members distinguish it from miRNA/siRNA silencing confusables.

qualifier: hexosamine, sialic acid and mannose catabolism
name: Amino sugar and mannose catabolism to fructose 6-phosphate
rationale: Members concern catabolism and phosphorylation of GlcNAc, glucosamine, sialic acid and mannose feeding fructose 6-phosphate, whereas confusables cover UDP-GlcNAc/CMP-sialic acid synthesis, GPI anchors or lysosomal glycolipid catabolism.

name: Notch target transcription via NOTCH3 and NOTCH4
rationale: Members describe Notch intracellular domain-driven HLH target transcription and its regulation, with NOTCH3/NOTCH4 distinguishing it from NOTCH1/NOTCH2 confusables.

core: Integrin cell-matrix adhesion and focal adhesion
name: Integrin focal adhesion and spreading with MET-FAK signaling
rationale: Members cover integrin/fibronectin/syndecan matrix adhesion, focal adhesion and stress fiber assembly and adhesion-dependent spreading, and MET-PTK2/tensin coupling is what confusables (ECM, EMT, Rho effectors) lack.

name: Extracellular ATP and adenosine purinergic signaling
rationale: Members cover ATP release, NTPDase hydrolysis and P2Y/adenosine P1 receptor signaling, distinct from confusables on KATP channels, aminergic GPCRs or lipid GPCRs.

qualifier: adenylate cyclase, phospholipase C and beta-arrestin coupling
name: Dopamine receptor G protein and arrestin signaling
rationale: Members are dopamine receptor signaling through adenylate cyclase activation/inhibition, PLC and beta-arrestin, while confusables cover dopamine release, behavioral drug responses or downstream cAMP/DARPP-32.

qualifier: response to food and nutrient levels
name: Regulation of appetite and response to food
rationale: All three members regulate appetite and responsiveness to food or nutrient levels, as opposed to confusables on eating behavior, ghrelin or HPA stress hormones.

name: Apoptotic nuclear dismantling and developmental cell death
rationale: Members cover DNA fragmentation, chromatin condensation and lamina breakdown in apoptosis execution plus developmental, involution and autophagic cell death, unlike confusables on PAK-2p34, dependence receptors or necroptosis.

name: pH regulation by organelle acidification and bicarbonate-anion exchange
rationale: Members combine V-ATPase acidification of lysosomes, endosomes, Golgi and synaptic vesicles with SLC4/SLC26 bicarbonate-anion exchange, Na+/H+ exchange and carbonic anhydrase, unlike confusables on phosphate, chloride cotransport or P-type ATPases.

core: Negative regulation of cell-matrix adhesion and motility
name: Inhibition of VEGF-driven sprouting angiogenesis and cell-matrix adhesion
rationale: All members negatively regulate sprouting angiogenesis/VEGF signaling or integrin, Rho/Rac and focal adhesion-driven motility, with the angiogenic arm distinguishing it from most confusables.

name: Autophagosome maturation and endolysosomal fusion
rationale: Members cover regulation of autophagosome assembly/maturation and fusion of autophagosomes, phagosomes, MVBs and late endosomes with lysosomes, distinct from selective autophagy confusables.

name: Phenylalanine and tyrosine catabolism with tetrahydrobiopterin synthesis
rationale: Members center on phenylalanine/tyrosine catabolism, phenylketonuria and the BH4 cofactor, with generic amino/organic acid terms, which confusables on sulfur, serine, glycine or glycine-conjugation pathways lack.
